d:
Aakraman is a classic 1975 Indian war drama revolving around Major Ajay, an honest army officer called to duty during wartime. The plot thickens when he discovers his fiancée's photograph with a fellow soldier, weaving romance, heartbreak, and patriotism into a powerful movie compilation.
Aakraman (1975) ek deshbhakti aur prem ki adbhut yuddh drama philm hai. ismen ek eemandar mejar ajay ki kahani dikhaee gaee hai, jo yuddh ke maidan men apne desh ki raksha karta hai. isi bich prem aur deshbhakti ke bich buna huaa ek dil chhu lene vala mor samne aata hai.
Movie : Aakraman (1975)
